title: 1688 Product & Supplier Finder — development preview
description: Development build, not yet live-validated. Select one mode and complete its matching inputs. All modes use a new isolated browser, not your signed-in Chrome session. 1688 may require verification; the Actor stops instead of bypassing it. Configure runtime and cost limits in Apify's native Run options.

searchMode.title: Search mode
searchMode.description: Keyword/image controls match supplied global-page HTML. Direct URL mode parses captured 1688 detail-page markup or identity-matched Product JSON-LD. None of these flows has passed live acceptance yet.

searchTerms.title: Product search keywords
searchTerms.description: Used only for Keyword product search. One product query per row. Explicitly clearing all keywords produces a validation error; omitted keywords use this example.

maxProductsPerKeyword.title: Maximum products per keyword
maxProductsPerKeyword.description: A separate product limit for each keyword, not the full batch. This limits products, not unique suppliers.

maxPagesText.title: Maximum pages per keyword
maxPagesText.description: Click Next page until this limit, the product target, or the verified last page. The Actor checks that product IDs actually change.

uploadedImages.title: Upload product images
uploadedImages.description: Image mode only. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 10 MB each. Each image is searched separately. Uploads and image URLs share a combined limit of 20 images. Upload/search selectors are implemented but the live upload flow remains unverified.

imageUrls.title: Public product image URLs
imageUrls.description: Image mode only. Direct HTTPS links to PNG, JPEG or WebP image files, not product pages, search pages, blob: links or Markdown links. Sources must be publicly reachable. Files are uploaded to 1688 for the requested image search.

maxProductsPerImage.title: Maximum products per image
maxProductsPerImage.description: Reset separately for each image. Repeated products count toward each image's limit but appear once in the final dataset, with all matching image labels.

maxPagesImage.title: Maximum pages per image
maxPagesImage.description: Separate page limit for each image. The supplied pagination markup must also be present on image results; that remains to be verified.

productUrls.title: 1688 product URLs or offer IDs
productUrls.description: Direct URL mode only. Paste https://detail.1688.com/offer/123456789.html or an offer ID, not a storefront/search URL. Extract visible detail prices, color variants, stock, attributes and supplier links. Login-gated details are marked partial; full specifications and bulk tiers are not guaranteed.

orderQuantity.title: Order quantity for MOQ checks
orderQuantity.description: Flags quantities below the displayed MOQ. Search-card prices are indicative and do not establish variant prices or volume tiers. No bulk subtotal is calculated from a search-card price.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Use your configured Apify Proxy for normal site browsing. Requires proxy access and may incur charges. Does not solve verification or guarantee access. No proxy/identity rotation is performed after access is denied.

skipFailedImages.title: Continue after a failed image
skipFailedImages.description: Image mode only. Continue after download/layout errors and preserve earlier products. A verification/access-denied response stops the whole batch regardless of this setting.

failOnNoResults.title: Strict failure mode
failOnNoResults.description: When enabled, stop on the first input error. When disabled, keep valid results from other inputs and mark partial runs. Runs with no products always fail; an unknown or blocked layout is never reported as a successful empty search.

saveCsvFile.title: Save product and supplier CSV files
saveCsvFile.description: Save a product CSV and 1688_suppliers.csv in the run's key-value store. Dataset records and progress snapshots are separate from these files.

csvFilename.title: Product CSV filename
csvFilename.description: Simple .csv filename. The supplier shortlist uses 1688_suppliers.csv. No additional supplier dataset records are created.
